notes: Material You: the island can take its accent and body colour from your wallpaper, and the colour pickers now lead with wallpaper swatches
New "Over the status bar" anchor — the island is drawn up at the cutout and a transparent strip below it catches the taps, so it looks right without losing touch

Optimised: the panel is only rebuilt when its contents actually change, measurements are cached, the window is only re-laid-out on a real change, and the waveform stops animating when it cannot be seen
The preview now shows a stand-in status bar so the anchor choice is visible
About explains why no ordinary app can draw above the status bar
